title: Preventive Maintenance, Ipil, Liloy, Sindangan RD.
description: PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE - PRIMARY ROADS - IPIL - LILOY - SINDANGAN RD. - K2013 + 344 - K2013 + 568
colour_meaning: Review: one strong sign of risk, or two weaker ones.

reasons.title: Price per km above 90% of similar works
reasons.detail: Official budget ₱90.2M per km; the 90th percentile of similar works (Preventive maintenance / asphalt, 459 past contracts) is ₱78.6M per km. Length read from the title: 224 m.
reasons.evidence: A weaker version of the price sign.
checks: Check the stated length and the scope, as for the stronger price sign.

reasons.title: Very fast award after bid opening
reasons.detail: Award made 7 days after the bid deadline (past road contracts awarded this fast had about twice the odds of termination)
reasons.evidence: Awards within 8 days of bid opening had about 2.1 times the odds of termination.
checks: Compare the bid-opening date with the Notice of Award date.
Ask whether post-qualification (checking the winner's documents and capacity) could be done that fast.

tests.text: Only one bidder at award (linked to late completion and to citizen-reported problems in past contracts)
